posts.t:
Some interesting activity on the pound/dollar. Looks like DP was reached (see yesterday's post). Zooming in on that pole reveals a nasty gap. It's as though the IT's don't want anyone along for the ride. At least that's how I see it. Nevertheless, a quick look using RTM glasses tells the story. QM-love and I missed it

Lastly, interesting to see the dollar and the pound rising together. Dollar broke up.

در آخر، جالب است که دلار و پوند با هم بالا می‌روند. دلار شکست صعودی کرد.

posts.t: Hey, Michal... on reply to Project's inquire, could you post it here? I am curious, too. Also, thanks for pointing out that I had my CP PAZ's plotted incorrectly.

posts.t: Yes,you are right. Blue CPPAZ was not broken. I was considering scenario what would happen if price broke into it. When price breaks into CP PAZ there will be retrace before it goes to the other side.. We don't know in advance where price stops. It can retrace a little bit and go to the other side of CP PAZ, or it can retrace some more. But it cant break into new PAZ which is above.
posts.fa: بله، درست می‌گی. CPPAZ آبی شکسته نشده بود. من سناریویی را در نظر می‌گرفتم که اگر قیمت واردش شود چه اتفاقی می‌افتد. وقتی قیمت وارد CP PAZ می‌شود قبل از رفتن به سمت دیگر ریتریس خواهد داشت. ما از قبل نمی‌دانیم قیمت کجا می‌ایستد. می‌تواند کمی ریتریس کند و به سمت دیگر CP PAZ برود، یا بیشتر ریتریس کند. ولی نمی‌تواند وارد PAZ جدیدی شود که بالاتر است.
